{{Top|leg}}
A '''repulsor tractor'''<ref name="DFRSB">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref> or '''repulsorlift tractor'''<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicle that was used in maintenance [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]]. [[Peregrine's Nest]] maintained several of them to assist in stripping down and rebuilding [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="DFRSB" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] utilized repulsor tractors fitted with [[Blast shield/Legends|blast shields]] as [[crash wagon]]s.<ref name="SWS" />
